Who we are

Professional HSE training services

At Zorent Safety Consult we provide professional Health, Safety and Environment training designed to meet the needs of individuals, organisations and corporate workforces. We are open to individual training requests and corporate training engagements, with flexible delivery options that suit different learning needs and operational requirements.

The company is incorporated in Nigeria as a division of Zorent Limited, and our work is guided by international standards alongside a clear understanding of local industry realities. We train people who work in oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, marine operations, logistics, power, hospitality and the wider service sector, and we adjust our examples, assessments and practical sessions to the hazards that our learners actually face at work.

Every programme is built by practising safety professionals who have supervised compliance on live sites, investigated incidents, prepared permits, carried out risk assessments and defended systems of work during client and regulatory audits. That experience shapes the way we teach. We keep theory at the level needed for competence and examination success, then spend the remaining time on application, discussion, demonstration and honest feedback.

Learners leave with the ability to identify hazards, assess and control risk, follow and improve safe systems of work, respond to emergencies and raise safety concerns with confidence to supervisors, contractors and management. Organisations gain measurable improvement in reporting culture, audit readiness and daily compliance. Our objective is simple: to develop competent people who contribute meaningfully to safer and more productive workplaces.

About us

International standards, local expertise

A provider of health, safety and environmental training and consultancy services, born out of a need for tailored solutions and better self-paced learning.

Zorent Safety Consult is a provider of health, safety and environmental (HSE) training and consultancy services. We were born out of a need to provide tailored solutions and to enhance self-paced learning. As a proud division of Zorent Limited, a company incorporated in Nigeria (RC No 8919612), we bring a blend of international standards and local expertise to the market. We equip individuals and organisations across Oil and Gas, Manufacturing, Construction and Marine sectors, among others.

Our mission is to elevate safety standards across all industries by empowering individuals and organisations with the knowledge and skills to create safer, more productive workplaces. We understand that safety is not just a regulatory requirement but a fundamental pillar of a successful and sustainable business.

In a landscape where industrial activities are rapidly expanding, especially in sectors like oil and gas, manufacturing, construction and marine, the need for globally compliant and locally relevant safety training has never been more critical. At Zorent Safety Consult, we are committed to bridging this gap by delivering world-class training solutions that are accessible, practical and tailored to the unique needs of our clients in Nigeria and beyond.

Our mission

To be the leading provider of innovative and accessible safety training solutions in Nigeria, fostering a culture of safety that protects lives, enhances business performance and drives sustainable growth.

Our vision

To create a safer Nigeria where every worker returns home safely every day, by equipping individuals and organisations with the knowledge and skills to identify, manage and eliminate workplace hazards.

Our services

HSE training and consultancy built around real work

We were born out of a need to provide tailored solutions and to enhance self-paced learning. Our programmes are curated by experienced safety professionals and built for knowledge retention and practical competence.

Service 01

Foundational and Advanced HSE Training

Levels 1, 2 and 3 · NEBOSH · IOSH · AOSH · OSHA

Our core training pathway takes learners from first principles of workplace health and safety through to the advanced risk management thinking expected of supervisors, HSE officers and managers. Levels 1, 2 and 3 build progressively: hazard awareness and safe behaviour, then safety systems, inspections, incident reporting and toolbox talks, then risk assessment, legal duties, auditing and safety leadership.

Alongside our in-house levels we prepare candidates for internationally recognised awarding bodies: NEBOSH (National Examination Board in Occupational Safety and Health), IOSH (Institution of Occupational Safety and Health), AOSH (Academy of Occupational Safety and Health) and OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) programmes. Delivery includes worked exam technique, scenario practice, past-paper drilling and one-to-one coaching for assessment submissions.

  • HSE Level I, II and III (classroom, virtual or self-paced)
  • NEBOSH International General Certificate exam preparation
  • IOSH Managing Safely and Working Safely
  • AOSH and OSHA awareness through to supervisory levels
  • Train-the-trainer coaching for in-house safety instructors

Service 02

Specialised and Bespoke Safety Courses

Built around your actual hazards, not a generic syllabus

Specialised courses cover the high-consequence activities that cause most serious workplace injuries. Every session mixes classroom instruction with practical demonstration, equipment familiarisation and assessment, so learners leave able to do the task, not merely describe it.

Bespoke programmes are written after we review your operations. We look at the job roles involved, the plant and equipment in use, your permit and isolation systems, your incident history and any regulator or client requirement you must satisfy. The result is a course that uses your own procedures, your own paperwork and your own site language.

  • First Aid and CPR, Emergency First Aid, First Aid Level III
  • Basic and Advanced Fire Safety and Emergency Response
  • Confined Space Entry, standby-man and rescue awareness
  • Working at Height, scaffolding awareness and fall protection
  • Permit to Work, Lock-Out/Tag-Out and safe systems of work
  • Authorised Gas Tester, Electrical Safety, Asbestos Awareness
  • Manual handling, housekeeping, PPE and behavioural safety

Service 03

Risk Management and Consultancy

Risk assessment, hazard identification and compliance support

Training changes what people know; risk management changes what the organisation does. We help clients build a documented, defensible approach to identifying hazards, evaluating risk and choosing controls that actually hold up in the field.

Our consultants work on site with your team to produce practical assessments and registers, then coach your supervisors to keep them alive. Where you are working towards ISO 45001 or ISO 9001, or responding to a client audit, we support gap analysis, documentation and internal auditing.

  • HIRA, hazard identification and risk assessment workshops
  • Job Hazard Analysis and task-based risk assessment
  • Legal and client compliance gap analysis
  • ISO 45001 and ISO 9001 implementation and internal auditing
  • Incident investigation, root cause analysis and reporting
  • Emergency response planning and drill facilitation

Service 04

Industry-Specific Solutions

Oil and Gas · Manufacturing · Construction · Marine and more

Hazards are sector-specific, so training should be too. We equip individuals and organisations across Oil and Gas, Manufacturing, Construction and Marine sectors, among others, with programmes framed around the operations they actually run.

For oil and gas that means gas testing, confined space, hot work and permit discipline. For construction, excavations, lifting operations, scaffolding and work at height. For manufacturing, machine guarding, LOTO, chemical handling and ergonomics. For marine, shipboard safety familiarisation, survival awareness and port operations.

  • Oil and gas: upstream, downstream and terminal operations
  • Construction and civil engineering projects
  • Manufacturing, processing and food production plants
  • Marine, ports, jetties and offshore support
  • Power, utilities, telecoms, logistics and facilities management

Accreditation

Certificates you can stand behind

Our certificates are accredited by the following bodies, so the competence your people earn with us travels with them across employers, regulators and borders.

ISPON

Institute of Safety Professionals of Nigeria, the national professional body for occupational safety practice in Nigeria.

OGTAN

Oil and Gas Trainers Association of Nigeria, the recognised association of accredited training providers to the Nigerian oil and gas industry.

CPD Standards Board

Continuing Professional Development Standards Board (United Kingdom), independent accreditation of CPD-recognised learning hours.

Russian Accreditation Boards

Recognition through Russian accreditation boards, supporting learners and employers across the Russian Federation and Eurasia.

Indian Accreditation Boards

Recognition through Indian accreditation boards, extending certificate acceptance across South Asian industry.

About the founder

Sanyaolu Oludotun Gbolahan

Sanyaolu Oludotun Gbolahan is an accomplished Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) professional, educator and business leader with over 16 years of experience across occupational safety, education leadership, professional training, administration and business development.

He served with Hybrid Group, one of Africa's acclaimed safety consulting and training organisations, as Health and Safety Trainer and Lead for Port Harcourt Operations, where he led HSE training, consultancy and client support activities. During his service he also supervised safety compliance across various client sites and operations spanning construction projects, manufacturing facilities and the oil and gas industry, supporting organisations in implementing safe systems of work, risk controls and workplace safety requirements.

He holds a Bachelor's degree in Plant Sciences and Applied Zoology, a Master of Science degree in Public Health, and professional qualifications including NEBOSH IGC, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor, ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, AOSH Certified Master Trainer (AOSH TTT) and numerous AOSH and IOSH certifications.

Through Zorent Limited and its Zorent Safety Consult division, he combines extensive safety, education and leadership experience to provide practical, competency-based professional solutions.

He is currently pursuing advanced (doctoral) studies in the field of Industrial Ecology at ITMO University, Russia, further strengthening his expertise in safety, environmental management, energy efficiency and sustainable industrial practices.
